actors.blurb: Péter Magyar has emerged as a key political figure in Hungary following his election as Prime Minister. His government's actions, such as the establishment of a National Asset Recovery and Protection Office to investigate past corruption, and his diplomatic efforts, including a planned visit to the Vatican, have generated significant media attention. Magyar's leadership and policy announcements, particularly regarding asset recovery and fuel price regulations, have positioned him as a central actor in Hungarian politics.
